query:
mutation SetRuleState($id: UUID!, $state: RuleState!) {
  setRuleState(id: $id, state: $state) {
    id
    name
    category {
      id
      slug
      name
      kind
    }
    conditions
    priority
    state
    origin
    autoApproved
    confidence
    evidenceCount
    matchingTransactionCount
    createdAt
  }
}
